mainEntity.name: What is AI website optimization for AI SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI website optimization for AI SEO involves using artificial intelligence tools and machine learning algorithms to analyze website data, user behavior, and search engine ranking factors. This analysis helps identify opportunities to improve content, technical SEO, and user experience, making the website more appealing to both search engines and human visitors. The goal is to enhance visibility and organic search performance by leveraging AI-driven insights to adapt to evolving search algorithms and user preferences, ensuring sustained relevance and higher rankings.
